description: This file contains functions and regex patterns for parsing, comparing, and managing release version strings for npm packages. It includes type definitions for release versions and publish plans, along with logic for determining publication channels, handling authentication, and deciding when authentication is necessary.

methods.name: parseDateParts
methods.description: Parses version components using regex groups, validates date and beta number, returns a ParsedReleaseVersion object or null.

methods.name: parseReleaseVersion
methods.description: Parses a version string into a structured release version object, supporting stable, beta, and correction tags.

methods.name: compareReleaseVersions
methods.description: Compares two release version strings, returning a signum indicating order or null if invalid.

methods.name: resolveNpmPublishPlan
methods.description: Determines the publish plan (channel and tags) based on the version and current beta version.

methods.name: resolveNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Determines authentication source based on provided npm tokens or auth tokens.

methods.name: shouldRequireNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Decides if npm dist tag mirror authentication is required based on mode, tags, and existing authentication.
